issues.description: Field mismatch for Animal.name: the UML in the problem statement declares the Animal attribute 'name' as type String (UML: "- name: String"), whereas the reference solution defines the field as a StringBuilder (private StringBuilder name) in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java. This difference is not a mere implementation detail — it changes the public getter/setter semantics students will implement and may confuse students expecting to use String operations or match the UML exactly.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the UML/spec by changing the Animal.name field to a String (private String name), update the constructor to accept and assign a String, and make getName()/setName() operate on a String. Alternatively, if StringBuilder is intentionally preferred, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly permit or require StringBuilder and explain why in the exercise text. Prefer using String to match student expectations and the UML.
